newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Q4 shr loss $0.51 vs profit $0.05.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Q4 shr loss $0.51 vs profit $0.05.

text.p: Three Months Ended Dec. 31 Year Ended Dec. 31
NOTE: Full name is Santa Fe Energy Resources.
Revenues for fourth quarter 1995 and year 1995 have been restated to conform to 1996 presentation.
Due to the public offering of Monterey Resources in November 1996, Santa Fe Energy's earnings include 100 percent of Monterey for the first 10 months of 1996, and 83 percent for the last two months.

Reported earnings available to common shareholders for 1996 were reduced by $65.0 million for special and extraordinary items, a part of which were indirectly related to the Monterey offering. The after-tax charges include $5.5 million of extraordinary items related to debt extinguishment costs, $33.7 million related to the tender offer for the company's 7.0 percent convertible preferred stock, and $36.1 million of proved property impairments, which were partially offset by a $7.4 million gain on the sale of real estate.
